card: This PR fixes a wallet unit test to properly exercise weight-based eviction tie-breaking in Single Random Draw (SRD) coin selection. The test added in PR #33223 passed the wrong pool variable and set a weight ceiling loose enough that evictions never triggered, allowing the test to pass even if the tie-breaking logic was reverted. The fix supplies the mixed-weight pool, adds an additional light coin, and constrains the maximum weight so SRD must evict heavier coins on ties to succeed. It touches only test code and has no dependencies.
changed_since_previous: Minor formatting adjustments in the test call parameters.
evidence: PR description and commit message note that the test in #33223 built `mixed_weight_pool` but passed `utxo_pool`, and that max weight (804 WU) fits any two coins so SRD never evicts and reverting #33223 still passes.
PR description references review discussion in PR #36255 confirming the test bug.
problem: The unit test added in PR #33223 failed to test weight-based tie-breaking in SRD. It constructed `mixed_weight_pool` but passed `utxo_pool` instead, and set a weight limit too loose to trigger any eviction, allowing the test to pass even if the tie-breaking logic from #33223 is completely reverted.

risk.why: Touches only wallet coin selection unit tests with no production code changes.

summary: Fixes the Single Random Draw (SRD) coin selection unit test to properly exercise weight-based eviction tie-breaking. It passes the intended mixed-weight UTXO pool rather than the default pool, adds a second lighter coin, and reduces the maximum selection weight so that evicting heavier coins on equal-value ties is strictly required for selection to succeed.
